Israeli Settlers Kill Palestinian Woman; Deutsche Bank Arms Israel Claim

A 72-year-old Palestinian woman was shot dead by Israeli settlers in the West Bank village of al-Duyuk al-Tahta, according to Palestinian health ministry officials. The Israeli military stated that the settlers fired after being attacked. Separately, a report claims that Deutsche Bank is arming Israel, leading to the killing of Palestinians and the shelling of hospitals.
